profile_text.body:
Box is a publicly traded company founded in 2005 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, trading on the NYSE under the ticker BOX. The company describes itself as an Intelligent Content Management platform, offering tools for storing, sharing, and collaborating on unstructured data such as contracts, presentations, and employee handbooks, with enterprise-grade security and compliance features covering GDPR, HIPAA, and FINRA requirements. Its platform includes workflow automation via a drag-and-drop builder, AI-driven malware detection, automated data classification, granular access controls, and e-signature capabilities that the company says are available at no additional cost with unlimited signatures.

Box AI is the company's primary AI product, tracked under the Notes, Knowledge and Meetings category, and it focuses on enterprise content intelligence including metadata management, governance, compliance, and retention policies. The site describes Box AI as drawing on models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google to deliver real-time summaries, analysis, and recommendations across enterprise content. The company also offers Box AI Studio, described as a tool for customizing and deploying AI agents within workflows, and positions its platform for use cases ranging from loan processing to employee onboarding.

Box's most recently reported annual revenue, per a 10-K filing covering the period ending January 31, 2026, was $1,177,253,000. The company holds CIK 0001372612 with the SEC. No litigation is recorded in the held facts for this profile.
